units.source_text: 男人一下子不知如何是好。

en.t: The man suddenly did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 本来想好就看眼下这一着了，

en.t: He had originally decided to pin everything on this immediate move,

units.source_text: 但难道能够声音粗暴地去盘问她绳梯的事情吗？……

en.t: but could he really question her harshly about the rope ladder? ...

units.source_text: 看来还是应该轻声柔气地，借口感谢她拿来报纸而委婉地向她打听。

en.t: It seemed he should still speak gently and use thanking her for bringing the newspaper as a pretext to ask her indirectly.

units.source_text: 假如是以打搅对方睡眠为目的的话，那肯定得用激烈的攻击性态度。

en.t: If his aim were to disturb the other person's sleep, then he would certainly have to take a fiercely aggressive attitude.

units.source_text: 要找个为难她的借口俯拾即是。

en.t: Excuses for making things difficult for her could be found everywhere.

units.source_text: 但特意假装重病人的计划也就不攻自破了。

en.t: But then his plan of deliberately pretending to be gravely ill would collapse of its own accord.

units.source_text: 实在很难说那种态度像个脊椎脱臼的重病人。

en.t: It would be very hard to say that such an attitude looked like that of a gravely ill man with a dislocated spine.

units.source_text: 在这里所必须做的，是要让他们认为自己作为劳动力是不派用处的，

en.t: What he had to do here was make them think he was useless as labor,

units.source_text: 至少要让那些人放松对他的警惕心。

en.t: or at least make those people lower their guard toward him.
They had brought him a newspaper,

units.source_text: 现在要想法子使他们已经软化了的心，更加没有抵抗力。

en.t: and now he had to find a way to make their already softened hearts even less resistant.
